description: Edit images, manage layers, and export documents through the local PhotoCraft desktop control channel. Requires PhotoCraft with control port 7878 enabled and a shared control token file.

configuration_fields.label: Control token file
configuration_fields.description: Absolute path to the private token file used by the running PhotoCraft desktop app. Enter the file path, not the token itself.

summary: Connect Nexts to the local PhotoCraft desktop app.
